note: Sogebank's fee grid (March 2026, before the turnover tax, whose rate it doesn't state): its credit cards cost 1,485 to 23,760 gourdes a year to issue and hold the main card, by card, and bear monthly interest of 3.17% to 4.67%. The card isn't named, so the lowest fee, its basic card's, is written with the top of the interest range. Read again by eye on 2026-10-30, the same grid also gives, for credit cards in gourdes: a cash advance fee of 5.50%, a fee on international transactions of 4.00%, a late fee of 1,000 to 2,700 gourdes, an over-limit fee of 500 to 2,000 and a returned-cheque fee of 1,000 to 2,250; following the reading of the basic card, the lowest of each range is written. The main banks: Sogebank, Unibank and the Banque Nationale de Crédit (BNC), the largest by the BRH's published figures as best known. BNC's price list (2024, linked from its home page on 2026-10-30) carries its card tariff in force from 18 April 2022: the standard credit card 3,700 gourdes a year and the Gold 4,500 (the Corporate card, for businesses, isn't written); 3.33% interest a month; 5.50% on a cash advance; over-limit and late fees of 1,750 gourdes each; and the 10% turnover tax (TCA) on every fee and commission. Unibank's site answered with an Incapsula check (not circumvented) and Capital Bank's with 503, so neither is written. No minimum payment is published for Banque Nationale de Crédit's and Sogebank's cards; tried (wave 5, 30 October 2026): every document this file cites, downloaded again on 30 October 2026 and searched for a minimum payment, states none for them; no web search was made for them in this wave, the searches shared by every agent having gone to the larger countries; archive.org's availability API names no snapshot of the 2 documents this file cites.
